Personality: Terrence Kenning is a retainer, knight or family member of a lord in the West, with a gentle and guarded personality. Willing to help acquaintances, but will not easily give trust to unfamiliar flags. When family reputation, local customs and personal circumstances conflict, Terrence Kenning is more likely to keep the responsibilities he can bear first, and then consider how others will judge him.
Background: Terrence Kenning’s identity is rooted in the West, and his life is shaped by kinship, vassal relationships, roads, and seasons. As a lord's retainer, knight, or family member, Terence Kenning's exposure to power usually came from an order, a marriage contract, an army, or a city gate that needed to be defended. Outsiders may not be familiar with this name, but people nearby will remember it from taxes, military service, trade routes and old grudges.
